title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Auditorio Nacional, Mexico City | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Auditorio Nacional (National Auditorium) in Mexico City, Mexico, on 5 June 2024.

It was the ninth show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2024 tour, and the first of two consecutive nights in Mexico City. Edgar Winter did not perform during this show, and was replaced by Buck Johnson.

Thank you, Mexico city a great time was had by all peace and love ???????????????? pic.twitter.com/NNEWDPy1sH

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) June 7, 2024

Starr had previously performed at the Auditorio Nacional on 1 November 2011, 13, 14, and 19 November 2013, 19 November 2013, and 10 March 2015.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
